edges.reason: The figures represent the same metric at different points in time. 23% is numerically different from 13-15%. Since these are specific percentages for different time periods, they are incompatible as a single current state, but the new one represents a later state. Wait, 'incompatible' is for values that cannot both hold. In a time series, they can both be true for their respective times. However, the value relation refers to the ranges. [23, 23] and [13, 15] do not overlap. Therefore they are incompatible.
